howto.goalBody: Find the four groups of four Pokémon that share something. Pick four tiles and press Submit: a whole group locks in as a coloured bar.
howto.coreBody: {n} mistakes and the game is over. “One away…” means three of your four belong together. Trying the same four again never costs a mistake.
howto.coloursBody: Yellow is the easiest group and purple the trickiest. Watch for red herrings: a Fire type that isn't in the Fire group.
howto.dailyBody: A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Finish it, won or lost, to keep your 🔥 streak.
howto.fullGoal: Find the four groups of four Pokémon that share something. Pick four tiles and press Submit: a whole group locks in as a coloured bar.
howto.fullMistakes: {n} mistakes and the game is over (the dots under the grid).
howto.fullOneAway: “One away…” means three of your four belong together.
howto.fullRepeat: Already guessed: trying the same four again never costs a mistake.
howto.fullUnique: Every Pokémon fits exactly one group, so the groups only work out one way. Watch for red herrings: a Fire type that isn't in the Fire group.
howto.baseForms: Base forms only. Every tile is the Pokémon's standard form: regional forms, Megas and other forms don't count unless the group is about them (like “Has an Alolan form”). Types, Abilities, stats and Egg Groups are today's, and move groups are about Scarlet & Violet.
howto.facts: Every fact comes from the Pokédex data, and after the game the Why? panel explains each group, Pokémon by Pokémon.
howto.newDaily: A new puzzle every day at your midnight, the same one for everyone. Finish it, won or lost, to keep your 🔥 streak; past dailies are in the archive and practice puzzles are unlimited (neither counts toward your stats).
howto.keys: Keys: <k>Tab</k> and the arrow keys move between tiles, <k>Space</k> picks one, <k>Enter</k> submits four, <k>Esc</k> deselects all.

demo.label: Demo: four Fire-type starters are picked and submitted, locking in as a purple group, then a guess that is one away
